title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
description: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.

items.title: Adept Fuyu-Heavy
items.content_text: Adept multimodal model that scales up the Fuyu architecture for digital agents, aimed mainly at UI understanding; Adept reports MMMU, VQAv2, AI2D and ChartQA scores against Gemini models.
items.summary: Adept multimodal model that scales up the Fuyu architecture for digital agents, aimed mainly at UI understanding; Adept reports MMMU, VQAv2, AI2D and ChartQA scores against Gemini models.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra
items.content_text: General OpenAI model whose launch post covers computer use and browsing; OpenAI reports 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 at about 40 minutes per task, plus ScreenSpot-Pro and Mind2Web results.
items.summary: General OpenAI model whose launch post covers computer use and browsing; OpenAI reports 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 at about 40 minutes per task, plus ScreenSpot-Pro and Mind2Web results.

items.title: Indeed-UI-8B
items.content_text: GUI grounding model fine-tuned from GUI-Owl 1.5-8B with grounding data and high-resolution training; the card reports 73.4 on ScreenSpot-Pro, 94.4 on ScreenSpot-V2 and 68.3 on OSWorld-G.
items.summary: GUI grounding model fine-tuned from GUI-Owl 1.5-8B with grounding data and high-resolution training; the card reports 73.4 on ScreenSpot-Pro, 94.4 on ScreenSpot-V2 and 68.3 on OSWorld-G.

items.title: Muse Spark 1.1
items.content_text: Meta Superintelligence Labs multimodal reasoning model for agentic work, trained to choose between writing scripts and clicking in computer-use workflows that span several applications.
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs multimodal reasoning model for agentic work, trained to choose between writing scripts and clicking in computer-use workflows that span several applications.

items.title: UXAgent
items.content_text: Usability-testing system that generates simulated user personas, has LLM agents work through a target website via a browser connector, and shows their survey answers and action logs in a result viewer.
items.summary: Usability-testing system that generates simulated user personas, has LLM agents work through a target website via a browser connector, and shows their survey answers and action logs in a result viewer.

items.title: CUA_World_State_Model
items.content_text: SEAgent's World State Model, a Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct fine-tune that assesses computer-use trajectories step by step from screenshots, used to label successes and failures and to drive curriculum task generation.
items.summary: SEAgent's World State Model, a Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct fine-tune that assesses computer-use trajectories step by step from screenshots, used to label successes and failures and to drive curriculum task generation.

items.title: InternVL3_5-2B
items.content_text: InternVL3.5-2B checkpoint with a 0.3B vision encoder and 2.0B language model, from a multimodal family trained with Cascade RL that lists GUI interaction among its capabilities.
items.summary: InternVL3.5-2B checkpoint with a 0.3B vision encoder and 2.0B language model, from a multimodal family trained with Cascade RL that lists GUI interaction among its capabilities.

items.title: OpenPhone_dataset
items.content_text: Training data for the OpenPhone mobile agent: the AndroidLab training archive plus a Hugging Face vision-language set with LLM-generated reasoning and reflection chains, formatted for GRPO training.
items.summary: Training data for the OpenPhone mobile agent: the AndroidLab training archive plus a Hugging Face vision-language set with LLM-generated reasoning and reflection chains, formatted for GRPO training.

items.title: OpenWebVoyager-opt-2
items.content_text: The second optimization-iteration checkpoint of OpenWebVoyager, an idefics2-8b multimodal web agent trained by imitation learning and then refined on successful real-website trajectories kept by GPT-4o feedback.
items.summary: The second optimization-iteration checkpoint of OpenWebVoyager, an idefics2-8b multimodal web agent trained by imitation learning and then refined on successful real-website trajectories kept by GPT-4o feedback.

items.title: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-MobileWorld-SFT
items.content_text: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on the MobileWorld dataset as a semantic world model that describes in natural language how a mobile GUI screen changes after an action, for planning by mobile agents.
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on the MobileWorld dataset as a semantic world model that describes in natural language how a mobile GUI screen changes after an action, for planning by mobile agents.

items.title: TianXi_Action_Grounding_7B
items.content_text: A 7B GUI action-grounding model from the SEA computer-use agent work, released as Qwen2_5_VL safetensors weights; its GitHub repository runs it on ScreenSpot-Pro across instruction styles and languages.
items.summary: A 7B GUI action-grounding model from the SEA computer-use agent work, released as Qwen2_5_VL safetensors weights; its GitHub repository runs it on ScreenSpot-Pro across instruction styles and languages.

items.title: TimeWarp-GPT5-Traces
items.content_text: GPT-5 teacher trajectories on the TimeWarp web benchmark, grouped by UI version, with SoM-annotated screenshots for each step and experiment logs, used to fine-tune web agents with LlamaFactory.
items.summary: GPT-5 teacher trajectories on the TimeWarp web benchmark, grouped by UI version, with SoM-annotated screenshots for each step and experiment logs, used to fine-tune web agents with LlamaFactory.

items.title: webarena-world-model-rlvr
items.content_text: A language world model for web page state prediction on WebArena, post-trained with RLVR from an SFT checkpoint and used for model predictive control of web agents.
items.summary: A language world model for web page state prediction on WebArena, post-trained with RLVR from an SFT checkpoint and used for model predictive control of web agents.

items.title: ACT-SOP
items.content_text: LoRA adapter for Llama-2-7b from MobileAgent, a mobile device control agent that adds Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) context and predicts actions on AitW screens.
items.summary: LoRA adapter for Llama-2-7b from MobileAgent, a mobile device control agent that adds Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) context and predicts actions on AitW screens.

items.title: Aguvis-7B-720P
items.content_text: Aguvis-7B-720P, the released Aguvis checkpoint: a vision-only GUI agent model trained first for grounding and then for planning and reasoning, acting from screenshots on web, desktop and mobile.
items.summary: Aguvis-7B-720P, the released Aguvis checkpoint: a vision-only GUI agent model trained first for grounding and then for planning and reasoning, acting from screenshots on web, desktop and mobile.

items.title: asil-qwen35-9b-rl
items.content_text: ASIL RL checkpoint of Qwen3.5-9B for operating desktop applications from JSON state observations with semantic actions written as code, trained on 320 task prompts after SFT.
items.summary: ASIL RL checkpoint of Qwen3.5-9B for operating desktop applications from JSON state observations with semantic actions written as code, trained on 320 task prompts after SFT.

items.title: InternVL3_5-2B-HF
items.content_text: HF-format 2.3B-parameter InternVL3.5 checkpoint, a multimodal model whose card lists GUI interaction among its trained skills and reports GUI task results for the family.
items.summary: HF-format 2.3B-parameter InternVL3.5 checkpoint, a multimodal model whose card lists GUI interaction among its trained skills and reports GUI task results for the family.

items.title: InternVL3_5-GPT-OSS-20B-A4B-Preview-HF
items.content_text: HF-format InternVL3.5 preview checkpoint built on a GPT-OSS language model (21.2B total, A4B), a multimodal model whose card lists GUI interaction among its trained skills and reports GUI results.
items.summary: HF-format InternVL3.5 preview checkpoint built on a GPT-OSS language model (21.2B total, A4B), a multimodal model whose card lists GUI interaction among its trained skills and reports GUI results.

items.title: LFM2-350M-ComputerUse
items.content_text: LoRA adapter for LFM2-350M trained with GRPO to click a button on the MiniWoB click-test task, reading the page as a BrowserGym accessibility tree and acting in a sandboxed browser.
items.summary: LoRA adapter for LFM2-350M trained with GRPO to click a button on the MiniWoB click-test task, reading the page as a BrowserGym accessibility tree and acting in a sandboxed browser.

items.title: lora_qformer_uitars_test_V1-400_merged
items.content_text: UI-TARS-V1.5-7B checkpoint with CoMEM continuous memory merged in, where a LoRA-tuned Q-Former compresses retrieved GUI trajectories into fixed-length embeddings for the web agent.
items.summary: UI-TARS-V1.5-7B checkpoint with CoMEM continuous memory merged in, where a LoRA-tuned Q-Former compresses retrieved GUI trajectories into fixed-length embeddings for the web agent.

items.title: MobileRisk
items.content_text: Annotated Android agent trajectories, split into safe and unsafe sets, for the OS-Sentinel benchmark that measures how well detectors flag unsafe mobile GUI agent actions.
items.summary: Annotated Android agent trajectories, split into safe and unsafe sets, for the OS-Sentinel benchmark that measures how well detectors flag unsafe mobile GUI agent actions.

items.title: OpenWebVoyager-opt-1
items.content_text: OpenWebVoyager checkpoint after the first exploration-feedback-optimization round: the imitation-learned multimodal web agent further trained on successful real-website trajectories judged by GPT-4o.
items.summary: OpenWebVoyager checkpoint after the first exploration-feedback-optimization round: the imitation-learned multimodal web agent further trained on successful real-website trajectories judged by GPT-4o.

items.title: SeeClick-aitw
items.content_text: SeeClick visual GUI agent checkpoint fine-tuned on Android in the Wild (AITW) episodes and scored on the AITW test set by action matching with the SeeClick agent-task scripts.
items.summary: SeeClick visual GUI agent checkpoint fine-tuned on Android in the Wild (AITW) episodes and scored on the AITW test set by action matching with the SeeClick agent-task scripts.

items.title: tti_webarena
items.content_text: TTI-WebArena checkpoint from the Test-Time Interaction work, a multimodal web agent trained with online filtered behavior cloning on WebArena tasks and set in the TTI evaluation configs.
items.summary: TTI-WebArena checkpoint from the Test-Time Interaction work, a multimodal web agent trained with online filtered behavior cloning on WebArena tasks and set in the TTI evaluation configs.

items.title: UI-Simulator_android_data

items.summary: Synthetic Android agent training data from UI-Simulator: prompts pairing a goal and a simulated UI element list with next-action responses, in RAG-free, RAG-based and two UI-Simulator-Grow splits.

items.title: VideoAgentTrek-ScreenFilter

items.summary: Cursor-detection model in the VideoAgentTrek pipeline that filters screen-recorded tutorial videos by cursor presence before Video2Action extracts GUI action trajectories.

items.title: weboperator-experiments
items.content_text: Run logs of the WebOperator web agent with gpt-4o on 812 WebArena tasks and a 155-task WebArena-lite ablation, holding per-task trajectories, search trees, screenshots and scores.
items.summary: Run logs of the WebOperator web agent with gpt-4o on 812 WebArena tasks and a 155-task WebArena-lite ablation, holding per-task trajectories, search trees, screenshots and scores.

items.title: AgentEval
items.content_text: Benchmark suite of the AgentGym framework: a 1,160-item test split over 14 environments, with WebShop and WebArena web tasks next to text-game, embodied, tool-use and SQL tasks.
items.summary: Benchmark suite of the AgentGym framework: a 1,160-item test split over 14 environments, with WebShop and WebArena web tasks next to text-game, embodied, tool-use and SQL tasks.

items.title: Auto-UI

items.summary: Trained Auto-UI checkpoints and BLIP-processed AITW features for a chain-of-action agent that predicts device actions from screenshots, previous actions and planned future actions.

items.summary: HF-format InternVL3.5-1B checkpoint with a 0.3B vision encoder and 0.8B language model, from a multimodal family trained with Cascade RL that lists GUI interaction among its capabilities.

items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct merged with the CoMEM memory module, which compresses past GUI trajectories into 8 continuous embeddings through a LoRA-tuned Q-Former, for web agent tasks.

items.summary: OpenPhone-3B weights, a 3B on-device model for Android GUI tasks trained with supervised fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning data and then GRPO-style reinforcement learning.

items.summary: ScreenAgent-2312 weights in SAT format, a CogAgent-based vision-language model that drives the ScreenAgent environment, issuing mouse and keyboard actions over VNC in plan, act and reflect stages.

items.summary: Data for FineState-Bench, a fine-grained GUI state-control benchmark: desktop, web and mobile screenshots with XML and JSON annotations of locate and interact instructions and separate localization and interaction boxes.

items.summary: Benchmark data for GUI grounding on synthesized multi-window desktops: 1356 samples over 585 images, with controlled occlusion, semantic distraction and clutter plus difficulty levels L1 to L5.

items.title: SWEeper-Bench-traces
items.content_text: Recorded runs from the SWEeper-Bench paper, 5,200 in all across 42 agent configurations, each with the coding agent's trajectory, shell commands and patch plus the browser verifier's trajectories and verdicts.
items.summary: Recorded runs from the SWEeper-Bench paper, 5,200 in all across 42 agent configurations, each with the coding agent's trajectory, shell commands and patch plus the browser verifier's trajectories and verdicts.

items.title: webgames
items.content_text: Task list for WebGames, a set of client-side web challenges for browsing agents: one JSONL file giving each task's id, title, description, page path, success password and tags.
items.summary: Task list for WebGames, a set of client-side web challenges for browsing agents: one JSONL file giving each task's id, title, description, page path, success password and tags.

items.title: WebsiteBench
items.content_text: Hugging Face copy of the 70 WebsiteBench tasks in Harbor format, where agents explore a production-level reference website in a browser and rebuild a full-stack clone scored by hidden functional and visual tests.
items.summary: Hugging Face copy of the 70 WebsiteBench tasks in Harbor format, where agents explore a production-level reference website in a browser and rebuild a full-stack clone scored by hidden functional and visual tests.

items.title: aitw-general-digiq-agent
items.content_text: Digi-Q agent checkpoint for the AitW General task set: an AutoUI device-control policy trained offline with a learned VLM Q-value function that re-ranks proposed actions.
items.summary: Digi-Q agent checkpoint for the AitW General task set: an AutoUI device-control policy trained offline with a learned VLM Q-value function that re-ranks proposed actions.

items.title: bugcraft-dataset
items.content_text: BugCraft-Bench data: 86 Minecraft crash bug reports from Mojira with issue metadata and attachments, used to evaluate agents that reproduce each crash by operating the game with vision-based LLM control.
items.summary: BugCraft-Bench data: 86 Minecraft crash bug reports from Mojira with issue metadata and attachments, used to evaluate agents that reproduce each crash by operating the game with vision-based LLM control.

items.title: ClawGUI-2B
items.content_text: ClawGUI-2B, a 2B mobile GUI agent model trained end to end with the ClawGUI-RL pipeline and GiGPO; the authors report a 17.1 MobileWorld success rate against an 11.1 baseline.
items.summary: ClawGUI-2B, a 2B mobile GUI agent model trained end to end with the ClawGUI-RL pipeline and GiGPO; the authors report a 17.1 MobileWorld success rate against an 11.1 baseline.

items.title: GT-r1
items.content_text: A GUI defect detection model trained with VLM-R1 reinforcement learning that inspects an app screenshot and labels it as a content display error, UI layout issue, missing UI element or no defect.
items.summary: A GUI defect detection model trained with VLM-R1 reinforcement learning that inspects an app screenshot and labels it as a content display error, UI layout issue, missing UI element or no defect.

items.title: GUI-SD-data
items.content_text: Training data for GUI-SD, an on-policy self-distillation method for GUI grounding, with about 6.99k screenshots and a JSONL annotation file read by the GUI-SD training scripts.
items.summary: Training data for GUI-SD, an on-policy self-distillation method for GUI grounding, with about 6.99k screenshots and a JSONL annotation file read by the GUI-SD training scripts.

items.title: InternVL3_5-8B-HF
items.content_text: InternVL3.5-8B multimodal model in Hugging Face Transformers format; its report evaluates the family on GUI grounding and on online agent tasks in OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena and WebArena-Lite-v2.
items.summary: InternVL3.5-8B multimodal model in Hugging Face Transformers format; its report evaluates the family on GUI grounding and on online agent tasks in OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena and WebArena-Lite-v2.

items.title: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-value-model-16k-qlora-adapter-v2
items.content_text: QLoRA adapter for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct that acts as the value model of the WMA web agent, rating world-model predictions of each candidate action's outcome so the agent can choose the top-scored one.
items.summary: QLoRA adapter for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct that acts as the value model of the WMA web agent, rating world-model predictions of each candidate action's outcome so the agent can choose the top-scored one.

items.title: SE-GUI-7B
items.content_text: A 7B GUI grounding model built on Qwen2.5-VL and trained with GRPO, a dense point reward and attention-guided self-evolutionary fine-tuning on 3,018 curated seed samples.
items.summary: A 7B GUI grounding model built on Qwen2.5-VL and trained with GRPO, a dense point reward and attention-guided self-evolutionary fine-tuning on 3,018 curated seed samples.

items.title: UIShift-7B-2K
items.content_text: UIShift-7B, the initial GUI-Shift model: a Qwen2.5-VL model trained with GRPO on 2K AndroidControl samples to infer which action led from one screenshot to the next.
items.summary: UIShift-7B, the initial GUI-Shift model: a Qwen2.5-VL model trained with GRPO on 2K AndroidControl samples to infer which action led from one screenshot to the next.

items.title: VeriOS-Agent-7B
items.content_text: A 7B OS agent model that carries out GUI actions under normal conditions and asks a person for input when it detects an untrustworthy scenario, trained in three stages with SFT and GRPO.
items.summary: A 7B OS agent model that carries out GUI actions under normal conditions and asks a person for input when it detects an untrustworthy scenario, trained in three stages with SFT and GRPO.

items.title: VideoAgentTrek-IDM-s1-7B
items.content_text: Keyframe detection model for the VideoAgentTrek Video2Action pipeline, the first inverse-dynamics stage that finds GUI interaction moments in screen-recorded tutorial videos before a second model labels the actions.
items.summary: Keyframe detection model for the VideoAgentTrek Video2Action pipeline, the first inverse-dynamics stage that finds GUI interaction moments in screen-recorded tutorial videos before a second model labels the actions.

items.title: Interception
items.content_text: A Windows input driver and C library that captures, filters and injects keyboard and mouse strokes per device, shipped with sample programs and a command-line installer.
items.summary: A Windows input driver and C library that captures, filters and injects keyboard and mouse strokes per device, shipped with sample programs and a command-line installer.

items.title: Mobile JSON Wire Protocol Specification
items.content_text: A draft WebDriver extension for automating native and hybrid mobile apps, defining sessions, capabilities, locator strategies, touch gestures, orientation, rotation, network modes and webview contexts.
items.summary: A draft WebDriver extension for automating native and hybrid mobile apps, defining sessions, capabilities, locator strategies, touch gestures, orientation, rotation, network modes and webview contexts.

items.title: Pix to App
items.content_text: A Python pipeline that turns a mobile app screenshot into an Android project, using Canny edge contours for the view hierarchy, Tesseract OCR for text and generated layout, style, color and string XML.
items.summary: A Python pipeline that turns a mobile app screenshot into an Android project, using Canny edge contours for the view hierarchy, Tesseract OCR for text and generated layout, style, color and string XML.

items.title: Qwen-AgentWorld
items.content_text: A language world model that predicts the next environment observation across seven domains, including Android screens, browser pages and desktop accessibility trees, released with AgentWorldBench evaluation code.
items.summary: A language world model that predicts the next environment observation across seven domains, including Android screens, browser pages and desktop accessibility trees, released with AgentWorldBench evaluation code.

items.title: AutoWechat
items.content_text: A simulated WeChat Android app from the AppSim-Bench suite, with chat lists, group chats, contacts and Moments posts backed by local JSON data for AI automation tests.
items.summary: A simulated WeChat Android app from the AppSim-Bench suite, with chat lists, group chats, contacts and Moments posts backed by local JSON data for AI automation tests.

items.title: droidbotApp
items.content_text: Android companion app for the DroidBot test input generator that registers an input method service; DroidBot sends text by broadcast intent over adb and the service enters it into the focused text field.
items.summary: Android companion app for the DroidBot test input generator that registers an input method service; DroidBot sends text by broadcast intent over adb and the service enters it into the focused text field.

items.title: firefox_antidetect_patch
items.content_text: A Firefox patch series against a Mozilla release tag, one folder per feature, that adds engine-level fingerprint, network and Juggler automation patches and builds the anti-detect Firefox behind invisible_playwright.
items.summary: A Firefox patch series against a Mozilla release tag, one folder per feature, that adds engine-level fingerprint, network and Juggler automation patches and builds the anti-detect Firefox behind invisible_playwright.

items.title: globot
items.content_text: A Python browser agent that drives Chromium through Playwright, turns the DOM snapshot into numbered clickable and input elements, and has an OpenAI model pick click, type, scroll or back actions.
items.summary: A Python browser agent that drives Chromium through Playwright, turns the DOM snapshot into numbered clickable and input elements, and has an OpenAI model pick click, type, scroll or back actions.

items.title: GPTVoiceTasker
items.content_text: Android app for GPTVoiceTasker, a GPT-4 voice assistant that reads screen elements through the Accessibility Service, turns spoken commands into press, enter and scroll actions, and reuses learned app transitions.
items.summary: Android app for GPTVoiceTasker, a GPT-4 voice assistant that reads screen elements through the Accessibility Service, turns spoken commands into press, enter and scroll actions, and reuses learned app transitions.

items.title: MM-Navigator
items.content_text: Example code for the GPT-4V smartphone navigation study: a prompt builder that sends raw and number-tagged screenshots plus action history to GPT-4V for the next Android action, and an action-matching evaluation script.
items.summary: Example code for the GPT-4V smartphone navigation study: a prompt builder that sends raw and number-tagged screenshots plus action history to GPT-4V for the next Android action, and an action-matching evaluation script.

items.title: OSWorld Web
items.content_text: Docker Compose stack of self-hosted web applications, such as banking, email, CRM, calendar, Overleaf and an AWS console, served behind a Caddy reverse proxy as the websites for OSWorld-V2 tasks.
items.summary: Docker Compose stack of self-hosted web applications, such as banking, email, CRM, calendar, Overleaf and an AWS console, served behind a Caddy reverse proxy as the websites for OSWorld-V2 tasks.

items.title: RUSS
items.content_text: Code and data for RUSS, which parses step-by-step web help instructions into the ThingTalk language, grounds them to page elements, and clicks, types or asks the user; ships a 741-instruction evaluation set.
items.summary: Code and data for RUSS, which parses step-by-step web help instructions into the ThingTalk language, grounds them to page elements, and clicks, types or asks the user; ships a 741-instruction evaluation set.

items.title: serve-sim
items.content_text: A CLI that streams a booted iOS Simulator to a browser preview over MJPEG and WebSocket, with commands and an Agent Skill that let coding agents send taps, gestures, text and button presses.
items.summary: A CLI that streams a booted iOS Simulator to a browser preview over MJPEG and WebSocket, with commands and an Agent Skill that let coding agents send taps, gestures, text and button presses.

items.title: showdown
items.content_text: Evaluation code for the showdown-clicks benchmark: eval.py checks whether a model's predicted click on a macOS screenshot lands in the annotated bounding box, with integrations for Claude, Qwen, UI-TARS and others.
items.summary: Evaluation code for the showdown-clicks benchmark: eval.py checks whether a model's predicted click on a macOS screenshot lands in the annotated bounding box, with integrations for Claude, Qwen, UI-TARS and others.

items.title: Steel Node API Library
items.content_text: TypeScript and JavaScript client for the Steel cloud browser API, with typed calls to create browser sessions, send computer actions, solve CAPTCHAs and manage files, profiles and credentials.
items.summary: TypeScript and JavaScript client for the Steel cloud browser API, with typed calls to create browser sessions, send computer actions, solve CAPTCHAs and manage files, profiles and credentials.

items.title: Steel Python API library
items.content_text: Python client for the Steel cloud browser API, with synchronous and asynchronous clients and typed calls to create browser sessions, send computer actions, solve CAPTCHAs and manage files and profiles.
items.summary: Python client for the Steel cloud browser API, with synchronous and asynchronous clients and typed calls to create browser sessions, send computer actions, solve CAPTCHAs and manage files and profiles.

items.title: Voqal Chrome integration
items.content_text: Chrome extension that connects the Voqal voice agent to the browser over a local WebSocket, reporting open tabs and running Voqal commands to open URLs, create or switch tabs and evaluate JavaScript in the active page.
items.summary: Chrome extension that connects the Voqal voice agent to the browser over a local WebSocket, reporting open tabs and running Voqal commands to open URLs, create or switch tabs and evaluate JavaScript in the active page.

items.title: webarena-setup
items.content_text: Shell scripts that load the WebArena and VisualWebArena Docker images, create and patch the site containers, serve a homepage and run an optional reset server between agent evaluations.
items.summary: Shell scripts that load the WebArena and VisualWebArena Docker images, create and patch the site containers, serve a homepage and run an optional reset server between agent evaluations.

items.title: WebCanvas_showcase
items.content_text: A showcase that connects web agent frameworks to WebCanvas online evaluation; its SEEACT folder runs SeeAct on live websites and scores the key nodes it hits on Mind2Web-Live tasks.
items.summary: A showcase that connects web agent frameworks to WebCanvas online evaluation; its SEEACT folder runs SeeAct on live websites and scores the key nodes it hits on Mind2Web-Live tasks.
